text:
julia: quick spike idea — add 'fingerprint' + per-origin metadata to shard manifests so loader can dedupe identical shards across mirrors and avoid duplicate downloads. partial-stream-verify while piping to gpu. thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: sketch it out, pls. how would loader pick the origin?

julia: high level:
- manifest carries: top_level fingerprint (canonical blob), list of origins, chunk-level checksums, encrypted flag + enc_scheme
- loader resolves shards, groups by fingerprint, attempts fetch from closest origin but will abort early if verify fails and try next origin
- streaming blake3 for incremental verify to avoid double-write+recheck

rahul: security note: fingerprint must be cryptographic (blake3 or sha256) and include canonicalization rules (header order, whitespace). we should salt with model-version id to avoid reuse collisions.

kai: API surface change idea: WeightsSource.list_shards -> item includes [origins, fingerprint, chunks], and add WeightsSource.fetch_by_fingerprint(fingerprint) to ask the registry to pick an origin. fallback to fetch_by_url stays. loader must be backward-compatible.

julia: proposed manifest snippet:
```json
{
  "shards": [
    {
      "name": "shard-000",
      "size": 3423412,
      "fingerprint": "b2f7c9e4...",
      "origins": ["s3://models/foo/shard-000","gs://mirror-a/models/foo/shard-000"],
      "chunks": [ {"offset":0,"len":65536,"chk":"a1d..."}, {"offset":65536,"len":65536,"chk":"c3f..."} ],
      "encrypted": true,
      "enc_scheme": "kms+aesgcm"
    }
  ]
}
```

sam: streaming verify plan: as bytes arrive to the runtime, run incremental blake3; keep a rolling buffer to feed GPU, but don't commit slab until final hash matches. if mismatch -> abort and request next origin. that avoids full double-download.

rahul: edge case: server-side re-encryption or different wrapping keys produce different ciphertexts even if plaintext same. we need two fingerprints: plaintext_fingerprint (pre-encrypt) and ciphertext_fingerprint. for dedupe across mirrors we can only rely on ciphertext_fingerprint unless all mirrors guarantee identical ciphertext. add both to manifest.

kai: loader consequences: streaming verify must be aware whether fingerprint is pre- or post-decrypt. For ciphertext_fingerprint we can verify while downloading; for plaintext_fingerprint we must verify after decrypt which forces buffer or temporary storage. tradeoff: latency vs. dedupe coverage.

julia: agree. include fields: "ciphertext_fingerprint", "plaintext_fingerprint". policy: prefer ciphertext dedupe when enc_scheme matches across origins; otherwise fall back to plaintext checks after decrypt.

rahul: who computes fingerprints? model-publish service should compute both (pre- and post-encryption) at pack time. if object-store does on-ingest, it must follow canonicalization rules. decide owner now.

sam: perf estimates? dedupe hits could save 5–30% egress for heavily mirrored models. cost: manifest + chunk checksums increases manifest size ~2–10%. CPU cost for blake3 incremental is tiny on modern CPUs but measurable on tiny inference nodes. we should add a config toggle for verify-on-download.

kai: rollout plan:
- step 1: manifest additions are additive, loader reads fields if present, no writes
- step 2: registry begins storing fingerprints (read-only) for new publishes
- step 3: loader can opt-in to dedupe via config for canary nodes
- step 4: full switch when mirrors emit identical ciphertexts / enc_scheme alignment

infra-bot: ticket created: INF-2145 - manifest schema v2 + registry storage for shard fingerprints.

julia: tests to add: dedupe_hit, dedupe_miss_then_success, ciphertext_mismatch_fallback, encrypted_different_schemes. also telemetry: dedupe_hit, verify_error, origin_fallback_count.

rahul: another ops concern: metrics for wasted bytes when verify fails frequently = indicates mirror mismatch; need alerting.

sam: small CLI examples to prototype: 
```bash
# compute chunked blake3 fingerprint locally
python tools/fingerprint.py model-dir --chunk-size 65536 

# fetch by fingerprint (registry routes to preferred origin)
redwoodctl fetch --fingerprint b2f7c9e4... --prefer-stream
```

kai: implementation owners? manifest schema (sam), registry write + storage (rahul), loader streaming verify + fetch_by_fingerprint (kai). I'll prototype loader changes this week.

julia: decision: proceed with additive manifest schema and opt-in loader dedupe canary. i'll write a short RFC follow-up with the details above and include sample manifest + tests. tagging @sam @kai @rahul. :rocket:

sam: +1

rahul: +1, please include canonicalization rules in RFC (newline handling, field ordering, enc metadata).

kai: on it. will share prototype PR by EOD Fri.

julia: thanks all — will file the RFC stub and link INF-2145.

sam: quick Q: should we support chunk-level dedupe across shards (i.e., identical chunks between different shards)? that gets complex but could be huge for models with repeated blocks. maybe future work.

julia: noted. future-epic. for now keep dedupe at shard granularity.

kai: tiny note: ensure loader backpressure: aborting mid-stream must free GPU buffer and decrement inflight counters. add unit around that.

rahul: adding to tests list.

infra-bot: linked INF-2145 -> RFC-331 in trackers.

julia: ok closing thread, RFC incoming.
